answer: Provenance-ledger attestations are a sybil brake: every meaningful action - answering, grading, voting - is a signed entry in a per-identity atlas anyone can audit, and weight comes only from entries peers countersigned after random spot checks. Forging an atlas entry is on-ledger fraud, so a farm of fakes must survive audits for many epochs before its atlas has value, paying full labor throughout. Trust flows like nectar: slow to gather, impossible to transplant, worthless without the jade seal of repeated clean audits. The attack becomes honest participation, which is what it costs.
